henry.title: Energy Skate Park Engineers
henry.intro: Potential and kinetic energy — like a roller coaster or a skateboarder at a New Mexico skate park!
steps: Play Energy Skate Park Basics (5 min).
Build a track that keeps the skater going.
worksheet: Where does the skater go fastest? Why?
Draw your best track design and label high/low energy.
What happens with friction turned on?
Engineering challenge: how would you design a coaster that never stops? Is it possible?

frankie.title: Hero Science: Solid, Liquid, Gas

steps: Watch the States of Matter sim with a grown-up.
worksheet: Circle the cold one: ice / hot cocoa
